method.coordinate_transform: WGS84 geodetic longitude/latitude at ellipsoid height0 to ECEF, then local east/north tangent plane at each polygon centroid; no pyproj or network
method.axes: x east, y north, metres; origin stored per record. Small-footprint tangent-plane measures only, not survey precision
method.dimensions: Axis-aligned east/north bounds plus GEOS minimum rotated rectangle long/short sides; long-axis bearing clockwise from north modulo180. No axis identified as building front.
method.neighbors: Only features already in the limited candidate audit index whose polygon distance is under65m; not a comprehensive nearby-building inventory. Repeated parent/part neighbors not deduplicated.

broadway_parent_part_check.conclusion: One source footprint represented as a non-renderable parent and a renderable part; never two independent buildings or two different plan tiers

broadway.status: Coarse named outer envelope plus an additional linked concave unnamed part; historical plan and floor-level assignment remain provisional
reasons: The two named features share a convex8-corner polygon with no inward recesses. A third unnamed building_part explicitly links to that parent and supplies a14-corner concave outline with wing-end/recess geometry; neither source defines which floor level the outline belongs to or which edges are historical external walls.
num_floors19 in both map features conflicts with22 floors in the gazetteer and21 in Wikipedia. Do not silently choose or average; floor-count conventions and scope unverified.
Documentary site area6600m2 is a site quantity, not the map polygon area or main-building footprint.

No adjacent geometry was unioned into the target, but no aerial/registration source binds every polygon boundary to the main historical building. Cannot certify exclusion of podium/site coverage merely from the map name.
Photo-reviewed separate pale Jahwa tower must remain outside the historical model; this small convex polygon has no independently validated mass assignment.

russian.status: Irregular elongated map polygon may guide provisional extents only; historical main-building boundary not independently established
reasons: The audit polygon has no holes and10 unique exterior vertices; the source index records fragment_count2, with a short stepped segment on the south edge. This is not evidence of two physical buildings.
Map num_floors5 conflicts with documentary4 floors. No height field establishes roof or tower height.
Documentary site1700/1700-plus m2 and gross floor area3264m2 cannot be used to derive or validate this polygon by division.

A separate low green garden pavilion, high roof tower and modern rear/curved neighbor appear in the reference photo; this map polygon alone does not locate their individual bases or establish inclusion/exclusion.
No complete historical site boundary, back wall or outbuilding registry is available in this extraction of4 source features for2 study subjects.
